name: Music & Art Camp
operator_name: Town of Greenwich Parks and Recreation
description_short: A five week town music and art program at Greenwich High School. Mornings from 9 am to noon offer band and orchestra rehearsals, a beginning band, or art classes, and an afternoon art class from 12:30 to 3:30 pm is open to music students, for children entering grades 1 to 9 depending on the section.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds and no prorating. Requests for full credit are considered before June 1, half credit on or after June 1, and credit is prorated once camp begins. Credits carry a $20 administrative fee.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Music and Art registration form. $420 is the non-resident fee per section (residents $335 early bird, $370 from June 1). Grades: Young Artist is for children who completed K to 3, music and afternoon art for completed grades 3 to 8, morning art for completed grades 4 to 8, so entering grades 1 to 9. No camp July 3. Harp and piano are not accepted; junior and senior band and strings need prior study.
